dispatchContext.memoryText:
Area «feature:relay-reminders»: earlier accepted tasks, newest first. Their decisions are in main; keep them unless this task changes them.
- 2026-10-14T14:33 pm-remind-tool-removal: Remove the PM reminder tool; keep internal reminders. PM agents stop creating their own reminders: results of tasks, child threads and answers to asks already arrive by themselves, and the reminder cards («in 5h») and self-wakes in idle chats disappear.
- 2026-10-14T12:54 relay-reminder-chain-cap: Cap long and chained time-only PM reminders. A PM chat must not keep waking itself with time-only reminders for hours or in a chain when nothing it can see changes.
Files of this area: src/rooms/council/server/council.ts, src/rooms/native-agent/bundled-agents.json, src/rooms/native-agent/native-agent-overlay.ts, src/rooms/native-agent/native-session-hooks.ts, src/rooms/relay/server/relay.ts, src/rooms/tools/pm-tool-families.ts, src/rooms/tools/server/tool-families.ts, src/rooms/tools/server/tool-presentation.ts, src/rooms/tools/server/tools.ts, src/rooms/workflow/server/workflow-tools.ts, src/rooms/writer/server/dispatch.ts, tests/pm-tool-families.test.ts, tests/pm-tool-mentions.test.ts, tests/tool-presentation.test.ts, tests/relay-reminder-limits.test.ts

- `src/rooms/relay/server/relay.ts` keeps the serialized `relay:items` value within `RELAY_LIMITS.maxStoredBytes` (about 200 KB): it prunes finished items oldest first, then truncates long text in open items. Open reminders and unanswered asks are preserved; storage remains one KV key.
- `src/rooms/relay/server/relay.ts` `remind()` refuses a time-only reminder (no `taskIds`, no `watchThreadId`) when `inMinutes` is greater than 120. The refusal throws an Error that says to tell the owner what is awaited and end the turn, or to use lane_pilot_schedule for a recurring check. Reminders with `taskIds` or `watchThreadId` accept any `inMinutes` up to 24h and skip chain counting.
- `src/rooms/relay/server/relay.ts` time-only reminder chains: a time-only reminder created within 15 minutes after a time-only reminder of the same thread fired by time continues the chain and stores a chain depth on the reminder. The third link is refused with an Error that asks to tell the owner what was tried and what to decide. A chain resets when the new reminder comes more than 15 minutes after the last time-fired one, or when it carries `taskIds` or `watchThreadId`.
